arStrings.szText: Lorath is recalling an emotional memory. He made a gift for Neyrelle, and he is proud that she accepted it--but he's also sad he never got a chance to reconnect with her in a meaningful way.
I started on it back when we were all together. I thought about giving it to her then, but...
Lorath is recalling an emotional memory. He made a gift for Neyrelle, and he is proud that she accepted it--but he's also sad he never got a chance to reconnect with her in a meaningful way.
With Elias, I tried too hard to control him, to shape him into what I wanted him to be. I didn't want to make the same mistake with Neyrelle.
Lorath is recalling an emotional memory. He made a gift for Neyrelle, and he is proud that she accepted it--but he's also sad he never got a chance to reconnect with her in a meaningful way.
So, after I finished the talisman, I left it at the Horadric Vault in case she ever came back. I didn't know she had taken it up...until I found her.
An emotional moment--he's remember the moment he found Neyrelle's body.
